feeds.description: Erin is a fitness model and bodybuilder who competes in the IFBB and has won over 14 titles. She is regarded as one of the greatest Figure icons in the history of bodybuilding.

feeds.title: Julie Lohre Blog
feeds.description: Julie Lohre's website focuses on women's fitness, strength training, and contest preparation for figure and bikini divisions. A former IFBB pro athlete, she shares expert advice on weightlifting, fat loss, and muscle building specifically for women. While her content leans more toward fitness and lean physique training rather than hardcore bodybuilding, it remains a strong and relevant resource for female bodybuilding and women interested in sculpting a toned, athletic body.

feeds.title: Amazons Fitness Magazine
feeds.description: Amazons Fitness Magazine was founded by photographer Glen Young to spotlight female bodybuilding and women's physique competitions, with the aim of changing negative mindsets surrounding women's muscular development.

feeds.title: NPC News Online » Womens Bodybuilding
feeds.description: The Women's Bodybuilding section on NPC News Online features articles, photo galleries, and videos focused on female bodybuilding. It covers competitions, athlete highlights, posing routines, and event updates related to the National Physique Committee.

feeds.title: DoU FItness Blog
feeds.description: Do U Fitness is run by a female coach who guides women through personalized training, nutrition, and mindset programs. She focuses on sustainable progress rather than one-size-fits-all plans, helping clients who want to compete in bikini/figure divisions or simply build a sculpted, confident physique.
